definitions.curve: Latent median/IQR over all_physical samples at each radius; x is physical median.
definitions.gain: relative_radial_gain: signed paired far-field secants / median local 0.2-to-0.4 secant.
definitions.calibration: Saved stochastic-rollout control steps; equal-width seven-bin median/IQR.

cohorts.perturbation: Paired sample rows across radius within each model; phase held fixed.

limitations: Descriptive sample IQRs, not training-seed confidence intervals.
One historical checkpoint per policy/model; no new training or physical rollouts.
Historical 12-joint Stage3 / 16D versus 23-joint Stage2 / 24D; not a latent-width-only ablation.
Both flatten: remaining 3-to-4 radial sensitivity is about 8.4% / 8.8%.
Stochastic control steps are temporally dependent, not independent episodes.

serialization.paths: workspace-relative; sources are not web URLs
